proposals.observation: 2 of 4 quiz starters dropped at intro_load — they never advanced past the landing screen. That is a 50% loss before question one. The email gate and q4 each lost one more. The intro screen is the single biggest drop-off point in the funnel.
proposals.proposal: Shorten the quiz intro copy to remove any paragraph that describes the quiz process or sets expectations at length. Replace with one direct, grounded line that names the tension the ICP already feels, then a single CTA button. The goal is to reduce reading friction so the visitor's next instinct is to click, not evaluate.
proposals.current_text: Welcome to the Way of Wealth money personality quiz. Answer a few questions to discover your money pattern and receive a personalised breakdown along with a free email series tailored to your result.
proposals.new_text: Something in your relationship with money isn't adding up — and you probably already know it. This takes three minutes. Find out what's underneath.
proposals.impact: Reduce intro drop-off, lift quiz start-to-q1 rate

proposals.observation: 2 sessions reached the email gate and neither converted — both exited without completing. At that stage the user has already invested effort answering questions, so the gate copy is likely killing perceived value at the moment of highest intent.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the email gate heading and sub-copy to anchor on what the subscriber is about to receive (a specific, grounded result) rather than on the act of handing over an email address. Name the three automation sequences available (Money Avoidance, Money Worship, Money Vigilance) as outcomes they are moments away from, framed as honest reckonings rather than generic 'tips'.
proposals.current_text: Enter your email to see your result and receive your free personalised money pattern series.
proposals.new_text: Your result is one step away. Drop your email and we'll send it — plus a short, direct series that goes into the story beneath your particular money pattern. No filler. Unsubscribe any time.
proposals.impact: Lift email gate conversion, recover at least one of two stalled sessions

proposals.observation: Today's published post ('Why does even the smallest money task feel like deadlifting 500 pounds?') maps directly to the Money Avoidance pattern, which is also the highest-volume automation (16 sent, 43.75% open rate). There is no evidence in the data that the post links back to the quiz. A reader who resonates with the post has no grounded next step into the funnel.
proposals.proposal: Add a single in-body CTA block near the end of the post — after the main insight lands but before the closing line — that names the quiz as a way to go further with what they just read. Copy should feel like a quiet, honest invitation rather than a prompt, consistent with voice rules.
